spec.purpose: Compare complete GDN segment pipelining OFF/two/three streams in one FLA DLL with the qualified narrow-QK stack fixed. Three independent original scratch owners separate preparation, ordered state and output; event dependencies protect ring reuse and join all output to the caller. Preserve original kernels, K16 arithmetic, BF16 boundaries, all numerical bounds, final-query/output liveness, full KV, compact MoE and dense correction. Require all512 original GB10 IDs, prompt IDs, first logit within0.125, actual callbacks and every owner check. Defaults and package remain unchanged; this does not qualify other contexts or release.

decision: Keep complete GDN pipelining disabled and outside the current package. All2048 original GB10 output IDs, prompts, first logits and actual callbacks pass, and all30 GDN layers activate in each enabled run. Both enabled schedules are slower than both bracketing controls; these single enabled samples do not establish a stable or material model improvement. The added179945472-byte scratch pool and preserved arithmetic are fully recorded. Continue a broader measured route, keeping the qualified23353.80795ms control and immutable performance/context targets.
correctness_scope: Four fresh processes use the same FLA DLL and fixed whole,CK,MoE,CLI,AOT and all original numerical coefficients. Only QRT_FLA_GDN_PIPELINED_SEGMENTS changes. Every8192 original prompt and512 generated IDs per process is checked against the pinned GB10 oracle, with first logit10.375,error0 and tolerance0.125. Actual callbacks,stream order,final-query/output liveness,complete KV,nine narrow QK/fused probability/PV owners,130 dense,nine coarse,30 adaptive linear and40 compact MoE boundaries are checked. All candidate/replay identities match across runs. Enabled runs contain30 complete pipeline markers and56 native-math submissions per layer, ordered state and caller join. No internal digest is a correctness gate.
timing_scope: Uninstrumented fresh-process q8192/out512 clocks. TTFT excludes model/engine load and ends at the actual first callback. Pool preparation is charged to engine load. Comparison order OFF,three streams,two streams,OFF brackets two single enabled samples. There is no stable retained-gain claim or decode gain. Native component walls and overlapped phase maxima are not model-time estimates.
